name: Cyclades Preservation Fund Grants
summary: Grants to local non-profits for fieldwork, community engagement and other projects on marine conservation, biodiversity and sustainability on the Cyclades and other Aegean islands. Non-local groups can apply with local partners.

steps: Online application or short email form for grants under €1,500

eligibility.rule: If non-local, is active locally or has expertise, involves grassroots groups, and gives local partners at least 20%

calls.label: 2026 application period
calls.note: Page gives the window as 09/01/2026 to 10/02/2026 without naming the format; both readings ended before November 2026.

status.quote: 2026: This year grant applications will be accepted between 09/01/2026 and 10/02/2026.

applicant_types.quote: Local non-profit organizations, associations, clubs or unions, social cooperative enterprises and/or other local non-profit entities, are highly recommended to apply

geography.quote: build capacity and encourage participation of the local society of the Cycladic islands and other islands of the Aegean.

access.quote: please complete and submit your proposal via the online application form below

window.quote: 2026: This year grant applications will be accepted between 09/01/2026 and 10/02/2026.

amount.quote: Although there is no maximum funding limit, applicants should note that CPF grants typically average €5,000 to €7,000.

consortium_required.quote: either alone or in collaboration with each other

effort.quote: When ready, please complete and submit your proposal via the online application form below, unless you are applying for a small grant (less than 1.500 €). In that case, please ask to provide you with a short application form, that must be sent via e-mail.

The CPF aims to complete the evaluation of every proposal within around 2 months of its submission date unless circumstances require a longer evaluation period, based on a mutual agreement between the CPF and the applicant.

eligibility.quote: Non-local applicants, already active in the area and/or holding significant expertise, can be also eligible for grants, when the proposed project involves grassroots organisations and allocates at least 20% of the budget directly to local partners.

after_award.quote: Grant disbursement will be made as follows: 50% in advance, 40% upon submission of an interim progress report, and the remaining 10% upon submission and approval of the final project report.
